question: $13.$ 设 $f(x,y)$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y^2}=2$，令 $u=ax+by$，$v=ax-by$，若 $\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u^2}+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}=4$，$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}=0$，则 $a^2+b^2=$ $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$
raw_question_text: $13.$ 设 $f(x,y)$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且 $\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y^2}=2$，令 $u=ax+by$，$v=ax-by$，若 $\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u^2}+\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}=4$，$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}=0$，则 $a^2+b^2=$ $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$
